verdict.description: fix when any finding is S1 or S2, pass otherwise

findings.description: one per problem you verified, at most 50; empty for a clean diff

severity.description: S1 must fix before the pull request, S2 should fix, S3 a nit

path.description: the file the finding is in, relative to the worktree; empty when it is in no file

line.description: the line of the finding in that file, 0 when it has none

claim.description: what is wrong, in one sentence

fix.description: how to verify or fix it, in one line
